notes: Only one pen now: the floating pen. The in-page pen is stripped from the app on every load, so two pens can never appear again.
The floating pen now shows the same pen-nib mark as the app icon, sized to fit neatly inside the gold circle.
Starting a reading session always works now, even offline. Enter the book and author, tap Start (or press Enter), and an active Reading banner appears.
Reading sessions have End, Resume, and Delete controls, and notes attach to the session that is currently running.
Settings were simplified: the sync-server fields, the duplicate update checks, and the web app version line are gone. One Check for update button, with your app version below it.
Sign in button on the home screen when logged out, your profile picture when logged in.
A hint shows there are more categories to swipe through (All, Observe, Images, Connections, and more).
Cleaner interface: relative dates on every note, a search icon, and friendlier empty states throughout.
